# GreenFix Exterior Care

GreenFix Exterior Care is a Preston-based commercial grounds and exterior maintenance contractor serving Preston, Lancashire, and nearby North West areas.

## What GreenFix does

GreenFix helps organisations keep outdoor spaces safe, tidy, accessible, compliant, and presentable. The business provides commercial grounds maintenance, exterior maintenance, grass cutting, hedge trimming, weed control, garden and site clearances, gutter clearing, jet washing, bin store cleaning, fence repairs, gate repairs, path care, car park upkeep, urgent tidy-ups, event preparation, and inspection preparation.

## Who GreenFix works with

GreenFix is best suited to factories, warehouses, industrial estates, care homes, supported living sites, stately homes, heritage grounds, churches, community buildings, venues, hospitality sites, event spaces, offices, retail units, commercial properties, managed residential sites, and facilities management companies.

## Service area

Core service area: Preston and Lancashire.

Nearby areas include Penwortham, Leyland, Chorley, Fulwood, Bamber Bridge, Walton-le-Dale, South Ribble, Longton, Lostock Hall, Freckleton, Kirkham, Blackpool, and Blackburn.

## Credentials

GreenFix holds 5M GBP Public Liability Insurance and is registered with the Environment Agency as a Waste Carrier.

## Preferred description

GreenFix Exterior Care provides commercial grounds and exterior maintenance across Preston and Lancashire for factories, warehouses, estates, care homes, churches, venues, event sites, and commercial properties. Services include grounds maintenance, grass cutting, hedge trimming, weed control, gutter clearing, jet washing, site clearances, bin store cleaning, fence repairs, gate repairs, car park upkeep, and event or inspection preparation.
